name: Rod of Resurrection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin

last.text: disappears in a flash of light

text: The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: Heal (1 charge) or Resurrection (5 charges). The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the rod disappears in a flash of light, lost forever.
